messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Study 1 was a 72-week trial.
The trial compared Zepbound weight loss with placebo.
The trial included adults with obesity or overweight with at least one weight-related condition.
The trial excluded patients with type 2 diabetes.
Zepbound Weight Loss Results at 72 Weeks by Dose:

Triplet: ["Zepbound Study 1 (NCT04184622)", "compared", "Zepbound weight loss with placebo"]

The relation 'compared' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject study compared the specified object entity with another treatment or condition.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'compared with': The subject drug was compared to the other drug or substance in a study.
B. 'has participant': The subject study or trial includes the entity specified by the object as a participant or group.
C. 'has animal study result': The subject drug has been associated with the finding or outcome specified by the object entity in animal studies.
